name: root-confinement
description: The engine confines filesystem access to the audit root it is given. Pointing a `scan` at a root that does not exist, or that is a file rather than a directory, must exit 65 with a root-not-found error frame and no gate. The staged-files scope must stay within that root. This pins the out-of-band root error so a caller that only reads stdout can still record the confinement failure, and so a missing root can never be read as a clean scan.
